title: Add minimal SQLite schema migration framework
description: Current schema initialization rejects older database versions rather than migrating them. Before external testers, add a minimal migration framework so campaign DBs can survive expected schema changes.
acceptance_criteria:
- Migrations have an ordered versioned structure.
- init/open path can migrate older supported schema versions.
- Migration failures are explicit and safe.
- At least one test migration proves the mechanism.
- Docs explain compatibility expectations for pre-release campaign DBs.
close_reason: Migration framework implemented: migrations.ts (SchemaMigrationError, migrateSchema, MIGRATIONS with v7→v8), schema.ts updated to migrate instead of throwing, 9 new migration tests + updated persistence tests, docs/storage.md compatibility section. Verification: 496 tests pass, typecheck clean, biome 0 errors.
